project_type: Nim DSL compiler/web framework (Doot) - compiles .do files to native binaries
build_system: nimble (doot.nimble), nim compiler with --threads:on --mm:orc from nim.cfg, db_connector path set in nim.cfg
test_framework: std/unittest with real SQLite in-memory databases (:memory:). Tests import from ../src/doot/<module>. Tests use suites and individual test blocks.
verification_instructions: 1. Compile the new test file with nim c -r tests/test_jobs.nim. 2. Confirm all tests pass. 3. Also run existing tests to ensure no regressions: nim c -r tests/test_lexer.nim, nim c -r tests/test_parser.nim
setup_instructions: export PATH=/root/.nimble/bin:$PATH. The project uses --threads:on --mm:orc from nim.cfg. For modules using crypto/auth, link flags are needed: --passL:-largon2 --passL:-lssl --passL:-lcrypto
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET network. Nim 2.2.10 via choosenim. nimble packages available. SQLite available via db_connector. No Docker.
contribution_requirements: Each phase has exit criteria that must all pass. Tests must be comprehensive. SQLite-backed. In-process async workers. No external services.
key_patterns: 1. Source modules in src/doot/<module>.nim. 2. Tests in tests/test_<module>.nim. 3. AST nodes defined in ast.nim with NodeKind enum + DootNode object variant. 4. Parser is recursive-descent in parser.nim with parseApp as top-level dispatcher. 5. Session/auth modules create SQLite tables automatically (CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS). 6. Server uses std/asynchttpserver + std/asyncdispatch. 7. Tokens defined in tokens.nim (tkJob, tkSchedule already exist). 8. Import pattern for db_connector: import db_connector/db_sqlite. 9. Test pattern: import std/unittest, create in-memory db, test CRUD operations.
directory_structure: src/doot/ - all source modules. tests/ - test files (test_*.nim). docs/ - specification docs. examples/blog/ - sample project. doot.nimble - package file. nim.cfg - compiler config.
